contracts_rationale: Bugfix Mission defines no interfaces: it changes operator-facing stale-refusal text and an internal stale-check result type; no contracts/ deliverable.
friendly_name: Recoverable stale-lane refusal after a halted in-run auto-rebase
purpose_context: When consolidate refuses a lane as stale after its in-run auto-rebase stops on a conflict with a sibling lane merged earlier in the same run, the operator today gets a remedy that cannot work: the rollback removes the sibling's change from the Mission branch, and the named implement command refuses approved work packages (#7755, #7754).
purpose_tldr: Make a consolidate stale-lane refusal name the real cause and a remedy that works for approved work packages.
